messages:
Maria D'Agostino: Quick heads-up — the postmortem for yesterday's serving latency incident is published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-11-02-serving-latency. TL;DR: a kernel regression in the 3rd-party GPU driver led to elevated KV-cache miss rates under certain batch sizes which caused tail latency spikes for a subset of routes. We rolled back the kernel, reverted the autoscale bump, and mitigated via temporary routing rules. Full timeline and evidence in the doc.

Maria D'Agostino: Key action items (owners + ETA) extracted from the RCA: 
- Sahil Kapoor: Canary pipeline for kernel upgrades + automated perf smoke tests (ETA 2026-11-09).
- Lina Gomez: Add KV-cache observability dashboards + alerts for mismatch signals (ETA 2026-11-05).
- Janet Chen: Update rollout playbook with explicit fallback policy for kernel and quantization changes (ETA 2026-11-08).
- Raj Patel: Run retrospective eval on top-20 routes to verify no quality regressions after rollback (ETA 2026-11-07).

Sahil Kapoor: Ack — I'll own the canary. Starting work today, will post PR and CI job reference in the doc. :white_check_mark:

Lina Gomez: I can pair with infra on the dashboard. Proposing a small set of indicators: kv_miss_rate, tail_p99_latency_by_route, evict_rate. Will add panels + alert thresholds.

Janet Chen: Noted on playbook. I'll add a decision tree for kernel vs model rollback and link the rollback runbook.

Raj Patel: I'll schedule the eval runs tomorrow and paste results in the doc.

ops-bot: Incident #2026-11-02-serve-latency closed at 2026-11-02T09:12:46Z. Duration: 42m.

Maria D'Agostino: Follow-ups/checkpoints:
- Weekly checkpoint on this RCA: Friday 2026-11-05 10:00 PT — 30m. Owners should prepare a 5-min status update.
- Please add owners in the doc and mark items as in-progress/blocked/done.
- If you need priority support (hardware or deep kernel access), ping infra-priv escalate channel.

Sahil Kapoor: Posting the initial smoke-test script I'll use (quick grep to validate KV miss behavior):
```bash
# run on canary host
journalctl -u serve-runtime -f | grep --line-buffered kv_miss | ts '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'
# synthetic load: 
python tools/loadgen.py --routes top10 --batch-sizes 8,16,32 --duration 600
```

Lina Gomez: Added the dashboard mock and alert rules to the doc (section 3). Requesting review from eng-sre by EOD. :eyes:

Janet Chen: Playbook draft is in the doc under appendix B. Suggest we run a tabletop next week to exercise the rollback path.

Raj Patel: Eval run complete — dropping initial numbers in the doc. No quality regressions observed on sampled prompts for top routes. Will re-run after Sahil's canary is up.

Maria D'Agostino: Thanks all. If anything is blocking your ETA, flag it in the doc and mention me. We'll close out items in the Friday checkpoint. :thumbsup:
